examined_formations.title: CHINA_STARTUP_LICENSES_SODIUM_ION_STORAGE_TECH_AND_WINS_RMB100M_ORDERS
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Hunan provincial government reporting states that Central South University professor Guo Xueyi's team licensed sodium-ion battery and storage-system technology to Hunan Qibiao New Energy under a 'use first, pay later' arrangement.
The licensed company began production in April 2025 and reported more than RMB100 million of orders within roughly four months.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The local policy explicitly allows zero-entry-fee plus staged payment, revenue-share or deferred-payment licensing so technology can move from universities to technology enterprises before large license fees are paid.
Hunan science-and-technology reporting identifies the licensed technology as the production-line basis for sodium-ion energy-storage products rather than a generic consulting engagement.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The licensee used the transferred technology to start small-scale production and enter energy-storage, special-vehicle battery and low-temperature application markets.
The parties planned a joint sodium-ion technology laboratory, showing continuing technical collaboration after the initial license rather than a fully detached turnkey handoff.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The executed license plus large order book is materially stronger than an asking price or unexecuted transfer listing.
Orders are not the same as collected customer cash or audited revenue, so the exact post-transfer payment-continuity floor is not fully closed.

The value layer still requires battery manufacturing, production engineering, quality control, customer integration and continuing R&D; the license does not create a narrow machine-routable operator position.
Public sources do not disclose license economics, unit gross margin, working capital, staffing, warranty burden or owner labor.
economic_signal: The licensee reported more than RMB100 million in orders after production began.
No public evidence in the reviewed sources converts that order book into received customer cash, recognized revenue or normalized net margin attributable to the licensed technology.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The university team owns the source technology and licenses its use; the licensee owns the manufacturing/commercial execution layer subject to the agreement.
Customer acceptance, production quality, supply chain, certification and application integration remain decisive external and organizational control surfaces.
The continuing joint-lab plan indicates that technical know-how and future innovation remain partly relationship-dependent.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_EXCLUSIVE_HERITAGE_IP_LICENSE_TO_ECOMMERCE_OPERATOR_WITH_RMB50M_PLUS_SALES
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Yixing government reporting states that Dingshu town government authorized Jiangsu Zhuoyi Culture in 2023 as the exclusive IP operator for Qianshu Dragon Kiln.
The same official reporting states that the licensee used its e-commerce platform to sell kiln products and achieved annual sales above RMB50 million in 2024.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The exclusive position covers development and commercialization around a centuries-old cultural asset and is reinforced by official certificates plus per-product digital identity and unique codes.
Municipal reporting states that the operator designed more than one hundred cultural-product SKUs and that the kiln drew more than 300,000 visitors in 2024.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The licensee combined the exclusive IP with physical ceramics, digital copyright identity, e-commerce distribution and anti-counterfeit controls.
Government and the licensee jointly undertook brand-protection actions against unauthorized livestream use, showing that the right is actively policed rather than merely nominal.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is a clean example of an exclusive third-party right followed by substantial external product sales.
The licensee was not a blank-slate micro-operator: public government reporting describes an existing platform and supply-chain ecosystem around many brands, creators and merchants.
The economic engine remains physical ceramic creation, inventory, creator/supplier coordination, merchandising, fulfillment, livestream/e-commerce operations and brand enforcement.
Sales volume is disclosed, but license fee, gross margin, returns, creator/supplier shares, fulfillment cost and staffing are not.
economic_signal: Official local-government reporting gives annual sales above RMB50 million after the exclusive authorization.
The reported sales are gross product sales, not normalized operator profit from the exclusive IP itself.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Dingshu town controls the authoritative cultural-IP authorization while Zhuoyi controls the licensed commercialization layer.
Artists, ceramic producers, commerce platforms, logistics and local brand-protection authorities remain material operating/control surfaces.
The decisive advantage is bundled with a pre-existing industry platform and supply ecosystem rather than available to equivalent fresh entrants on similar terms.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_OPERATING_SOLAR_PROJECT_COMPANIES_TRANSFER_CONTROL_TO_THIRD_PARTY_BUYER
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Jinko Power's audited 2025 annual report states that a 2025 transaction transferred 100% of the holding company for four industrial/commercial distributed-PV project companies together with the station equipment for a total transaction price of about RMB286.5 million.
The annual report states that the equity transfer completed business-registration changes by year-end and the seller had received all consideration other than the quality-retention amount.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current National Energy Administration rules allow a distributed-PV project investor to appoint a professional third party as the O&M responsible entity after commissioning.
Current industry disclosure describes power-station project companies as receiving power-sale settlement from grid or electricity customers under grid-connection and power-purchase arrangements.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The market uses project-company equity transfer as a control-transfer rail for operating energy assets rather than requiring the original developer to remain owner.
The seller can continue to provide O&M as a separate contracted service after sale without retaining asset control, demonstrating separation between ownership and recurring maintenance execution.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The transaction proves a completed control change and a standardized external revenue mechanism can remain attached to an operating energy asset.

The reviewed disclosure does not isolate buyer-side realized post-closing electricity receipts for these exact four projects, so exact post-transfer external-payment continuity remains unclosed rather than inferred from the industry model.
A roughly RMB286.5 million transaction is categorically outside a fresh independent small-operator acquisition budget.

Even with outsourced O&M, project ownership carries capital, financing, grid-contract, safety, curtailment, power-price and regulatory risk; the scarce position is financed infrastructure ownership rather than a routing layer.
economic_signal: The completed transaction has an explicit total price of about RMB286.5 million and the seller received substantially all consideration.
Exact post-closing electricity revenue, debt service, O&M fee, taxes, curtailment and buyer net return for the four transferred stations are not separately disclosed.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The buyer receives project-company control, while grid operators and power-market rules control connection, dispatch and settlement.
Professional O&M can be outsourced, but asset owners remain responsible for investment, contracts and safety/compliance obligations.
The control position is reproducible primarily through large capital deployment and project acquisition, not through a small operator's distinct data/routing asset.
